rationale: Price is sitting at 82% of today's range near the 9-EMA with no clear momentum — the last five 1-minute candles show a sharp drop followed by a weak recovery, suggesting indecision rather than a directional setup. The stock gapped up ~4.8% on a negative earnings miss (revenue and EPS both below consensus, stock down 26.7% over the past month), creating a conflicted backdrop where the gap could either fade or hold. With spread-adjusted risk/reward unclear and no clean technical level to anchor a stop, the evidence does not favor committing capital in either direction.
